source_tools.relevance: Sequence properties, domain matches, cysteine motif, and homolog evidence

entities.name: RlmN
observations: Reviewed RlmN homologs are annotated as EC 2.1.1.192 dual-specificity RNA methyltransferases.
RlmN methylates adenine C2 in 23S rRNA at A2503 and in tRNA at A37.
RlmN binds one [4Fe–4S] cluster coordinated by three cysteines and an exchangeable S-adenosyl-L-methionine.

The reaction uses S-adenosyl-L-methionine and produces 5'-deoxyadenosine, methionine, and S-adenosyl-L-homocysteine; reduced ferredoxin supplies reducing equivalents in the curated reaction representation.
The rRNA product m2A2503 supports proofreading at the peptidyl-transferase center; the protein is cytoplasmic in reviewed references.

The chemistry is radical-SAM methylation involving a methylated cysteine intermediate, as represented by reviewed RlmN feature annotations.
